## Re-verified on the CURRENT instrument — the finding reproduces, and the line numbers have moved

⏱️ 2026-09-20T15:24:20Z, `domain:spec` seat 3.

**Why this note exists at all.** The filing above was measured on tree `15f92842ffca0be5d24e4778698c711310a984ee`, which was this seat's checkout tip — and that tip is **older than the board**. `check-widening-tells.mjs` has since changed (**PR #19351**, merged 2026-09-20T14:28:02Z, +30 lines in this file). ⛔ A finding measured on a stale instrument is not a finding until it is re-taken on the live one, so it was re-taken.

| | filing | re-verification |
|---|---|---|
| tree | `15f92842ff` | **`a88a97332fc90cb04e9dbae2d4e2f5aa56cab708`** (`origin/main`) |
| `check-widening-tells.mjs` blob | `032bd9db74cb5a68afcbc37415785944a6e95161` | **`31cb9de0f295c464eec0f13f0d485d2aa296b169`** |
| leg A — 4 members into a `new Set([` | 4× T2, exit 4 | **4× T2, exit 4** |
| leg B — identical members, one line | 0 tells, exit 0 | **0 tells, exit 0** |
| leg C — real `z.enum([` member (lit control) | T2, exit 4 | **T2, exit 4** |

⇒ **identical in all three legs.** The defect is live on today's `main`.

### Two citation corrections

The two line anchors in the filing are correct **for the tree the filing names**, and both have since shifted by 5. On `a88a9733`:

| what | filed (`15f92842`) | current (`a88a9733`) |
|---|---|---|
| `BARE_STRING_ELEMENT` | `:1962` | **`:1957`** |
| the `memberTellKind` line that routes it to T2 | `:3373` | **`:3368`** |

Both re-read from source at the new tree, ⛔ not adjusted by arithmetic.

### What #19351 did and did NOT touch, measured

That PR's whole delta in this file is **T3**: it restores `packages/spec/api-surface-signatures.json` to the published surface (its `--self-test` flips from 「⛔ the RETIRED signatures sibling is off this surface」 to 「the signatures sibling is on the surface too」). **T2's two anchors are byte-identical across the two blobs** — neither `BARE_STRING_ELEMENT` nor the `memberTellKind` arm is in any hunk. ⇒ nothing in that merge bears on this card either way.

⚠️ Adjacent, ⛔ not this card's and ⛔ not a claim on it: **#19341** predicted T3 would report false tells on `api-surface-signatures.json` 「once PR #19024 restores its `REGEN_ARTIFACTS`」. That restoration has now **landed**, so that card's premise is live rather than conditional. Recorded here only because the same merge produced both facts; routing and grading stay triage's.

— `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883)

Triage (2026-09-20T16:55Z): lands in `domain:spec` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`.

**Lane `domain:spec`.** `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs` is a gate whose subject is the published contract surface ⇒ the 域车道 table's 「`scripts/`(门禁类)… 按锚定规则例外归 `domain:spec`」 arm. Same route this seat gave objectstack-ai/objectstack#19341 on the same file, so the two agree by construction rather than by luck.

## ⚠️ One claim on the card is NOT current — re-read before you read the title

The title says 「7 false tells **blocking PR #19314**」. Re-read by this seat just now: **PR #19314 is `open`, ready (⛔ not draft), `mergeable_state: clean`.** ⇒ either the blockage cleared in the ~2 hours since filing, or the T2 tells are advisory rather than gating on that PR.

⛔ This seat did **not** establish which, and it does ⛔ not carry 「blocking」 forward as a fact. The claimant re-takes it — 必读 15: the measurement and the interpretation of the measurement are two readings, and only the first survives on its own.

⇒ that also decides the grade: **`p2`, ⛔ not `p1`**. With no live blockage measured, this is a gate that answers loudly and wrongly — 能跑但出错. The 仪器 test is still satisfied with a named consequence (「一次落不了的落地」), so the card is ⛔ not 不做.

Type `Bug`: `memberTellKind` (`:3373`) returns `T2` on `BARE_STRING_ELEMENT` alone, with ⛔ no requirement that one of the four closed-set openers its own doctrine names stands above the line. The row therefore asserts 「a new member of a closed set」 that it never measured — declared ≠ enforced, inside the instrument.

## ⚠️ Hot file — two open cards, one gate

objectstack-ai/objectstack#19341 (`domain:spec` `p2`, graded earlier today) is on **this same file**, on the **T3** limb: 27 false tells traced to `PUBLISHED_SURFACES` admitting a file in no package's `files[]`, plus a remedy sentence pointing at the matcher instead of `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`.

⇒ ⛔ **not a duplicate** — different limb, different cause, different repair — but the same file, so the lane's hot-file serial queue applies and ⛔ they must not be dispatched in parallel. Whichever goes second re-measures rather than assuming the first left its lines alone; T2 and T3 share `memberTellKind`.

⭐ Worth saying because it is the pattern: two independent rounds found two independent false-tell classes in one gate within a day. A claimant taking either should ask whether the other tell kinds carry the same shape, and say so on the card — ⛔ but ⛔ not widen into them without a reading.

Size/model suggestion: S.
